$comment: Single source of truth for the BUILD_PROMPT.md §8 quality-bar numbers and how each is measured. Owner: qa-lead. A gate value changes only with Director approval, logged in docs/qa/test-plan.md (change log). Every gate names its source. Read by tests/perf/bundle-budget.mjs, tests/perf/lhci-config.cjs (lighthouserc*.cjs), tests/perf/web-vitals.spec.ts and tests/perf/fps-probe.mjs.

gzip.library: node:zlib gzipSync, one file at a time (each file is served and compressed separately)
gzip.evidence: Measured 2026-09-30: GitHub Pages served pages.github.com/js/application.js at exactly the zlib level-6 size (2158 B); jquery.js and css/pages.css were served 0.57% and 0.68% above level 6. Vite 8.3.1's own build reporter prints about 1.1% above level 6. Level 9 would under-report what users download.

initialJs.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: 'Initial JS < 250 KB gzip before the 3D chunk'
initialJs.counts: Every JS file the entry HTML loads eagerly (module and classic script src, inline scripts, modulepreload, preload as=script) plus their static-import closure, taken from V8's own module parser. Dynamic-import-only chunks are excluded and reported separately.
initialJs.warnSource: qa-lead: non-blocking early warning; covers the up-to-1.1% gap between zlib level 6 and served or Vite-reported sizes. Approved by the Director, 2026-09-30 (test plan §16).

forbiddenInInitialGraph.name: three.js (also catches @react-three/fiber, drei and postprocessing, which all import three)
forbiddenInInitialGraph.source: docs/reports/phase-0-plan.md WP-B0 item 2: 'three, R3F, drei and postprocessing are reachable only through a lazy chunk'. three's core module sets window.__THREE__ when it is imported (checked in three@0.186.1, build/three.core.js).

css.note: Reported only. BUILD_PROMPT.md §8 sets no CSS budget.

lighthouse.aggregationNote: LHCI's default aggregation is 'optimistic' (best run), so every assertion sets 'median' explicitly.

performanceScore.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: 'Lighthouse performance ≥ 90 on the landing page'

totalBlockingTimeMs.source: Lab proxy for BUILD_PROMPT.md §8 'INP < 200 ms'. https://web.dev/articles/tbt (updated 2025-10-15): 'less than 200 milliseconds when tested on average mobile hardware' and TBT is 'a proxy metric for INP in the lab'.

webVitals.viewportsSource: Names from visual.viewports. 390 added in WP-Q1 (2026-09-30): Lighthouse's default mobile run reported CLS 0 for a late 300 px banner that the browser's own Layout Instability API measured at 0.307 at phone width (test plan §6.3).
webVitals.minObserveSource: WP-Q2, 2026-10-01: the page is hidden no earlier than this much page time after navigation start. With only load, network idle and settleMs, a fast page was hidden about 2 s in, so an LCP element at 2.7 s and a layout shift at 3 s went unseen and passed (negative controls NC-V2b and NC-V3). 5000 ms covers the 2500 ms LCP gate twice over and a whole 5 s CLS session window. A method change; no gate value changed.

inpMs.activeFrom: Phase 2, once the builder has interactions to script
inpMs.maxRunSpreadSource: Approved by the Director, 2026-09-30 (test plan §16): INP is gated at CPU x4 as well as x1. If the x4 runs spread by more than this, (max - min) / median, the x4 result is INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL.

fps.maxRunSpreadSource: qa-lead: if (max - min) / median of the per-run averages exceeds this, the runs disagree and the result is INCONCLUSIVE, not a measurement. Added after uncapped SwiftShader gave 379, 3.8 and 2.2 fps on one scene (2026-09-30). Approved by the Director, 2026-09-30 (test plan §16).
fps.metric: avgFps = (frames - 1) / elapsed seconds while the scene plays its scripted, time-based camera path, with the browser frame-rate limit off. Also recorded: 1% low = 1000 / p99 frame interval, min fps, p50/p95/p99 frame time.

referenceLaptop.hardware: Intel Core Ultra 7 155H laptop on its Intel Arc iGPU (dual-channel memory), Google Chrome with hardware acceleration on
referenceLaptop.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: '60 fps in the 3D garage on a mid laptop iGPU (reference: Intel Core Ultra 7 155H with Arc iGPU, Chrome with hardware acceleration on)'

desktop.hardware: A desktop GPU named by the Director; the high-end desktop run also covers this bar

highEndDesktop.hardware: A high-end discrete desktop GPU named by the Director
highEndDesktop.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: '120 fps on a high-end desktop GPU'

ciProxy.note: Relative regression signal only, never a pass of the §8 bar. Headless Chromium caps requestAnimationFrame at 60 Hz even with --disable-frame-rate-limit (measured 2026-09-30), so the proxy only sees scenes that render below 60 fps under SwiftShader. Becomes blocking only after its noise floor is measured (10 runs of one build) and the Director approves the threshold.

console.warningsSource: The Director, 2026-10-01 (docs/reports/progress.md, WP-Q2 next step 4): the smoke fails on app warnings. Two environment notices are allowed in tests/e2e/problems.ts, from build-lead's proposal: Chromium's software-WebGL fallback notice, and ANGLE's 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' notice when Chromium reads a WebGL canvas back on SwiftShader. A method change; no §8 number changed.
console.soakSource: QA-P0-005, approved by the Director 2026-10-01: in the dark e2e project at these widths, each route's smoke test watches the page for this long after network idle, so a console error or unhandled rejection that comes about 1 to 1.5 s after navigation still fails. Without it, a rejection 1 s after start passed all 112 smoke tests (WP-Q2 negative control NC-F3).
console.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: 'Zero console errors. Zero unhandled promise rejections.' A failed same-origin request also logs a console error in Chromium (measured 2026-09-30).

accessibility.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: 'WCAG 2.1 AA for all non-3D UI; full keyboard path through the builder.'

visual.source: Widths: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8 'every step at 390 px, 768 px, 1440 px'. Themes: BUILD_PROMPT.md §6 'dark theme first, light theme supported'. Heights and maxDiffPixelRatio: approved by the Director, 2026-09-30 (test plan §16); maxDiffPixelRatio is re-checked in the pinned image when the first baselines are made (Phase 2). deviceScaleFactor: qa-lead (test plan §5). threshold 0.2 is Playwright's default per-pixel YIQ tolerance.

compatibility.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §8: 'Every compatibility rule has a passing positive and negative test.' The unknown-data rule is qa-lead's: a null spec can never prove a fit.

models.goldenSource: BUILD_PROMPT.md §5.3: 'the model must reproduce the published number within ±5%'
models.heldOutSource: .claude/agents/data-auditor.md: 'Pick 5 held-out published results ... model error over 10% is a blocker.'

dataAudit.seedFormat: rig-lab-audit:<phase>:<full 40-hex commit SHA of the integration branch being audited>
dataAudit.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §2 Phase 1: 'data-auditor spot-checks 10% of all numbers'; .claude/agents/data-auditor.md: 'random 10% of records (seeded, so the sample is reproducible)'

definitionOfDone.source: BUILD_PROMPT.md §9: 'A new visitor can, in under 5 minutes: ...'. The D1 rule, approved by the Director, 2026-09-30 (test plan §16): of usabilityParticipants first-time visitors, at least minFinishingUnaided finish unaided in under firstVisitMaxMinutes, and the median time is under maxMedianMinutes.
